name: exhaust-order/juggernaut-picks-before-charons-ashes-kills
source: game: Hook.AfterCardExhausted via CombatState.IterateHookListeners (the owner's powers before its relics)
doc: CHARONS_ASHES (3 to every enemy) comes after FEEL_NO_PAIN_POWER's block, so JUGGERNAUT_POWER picks among all three slimes, the one CHARONS_ASHES would kill included. A STRIKE_IRONCLAD leaves the first slime on 3, and this seed's three-way pick is that slime: it dies to JUGGERNAUT_POWER and CHARONS_ASHES then hits the two others. Run the other way round, CHARONS_ASHES kills it first and JUGGERNAUT_POWER hits one of the other two as well.

xfail_engines.old: old runs the relics' AfterCardExhausted before the owner's powers (hook_open: order play_effect AfterCardExhausted kind relic>power, fix/exhaust-listener-order 2fcefac9 not landed).
xfail_engines.core2: old runs the relics' AfterCardExhausted before the owner's powers (hook_open: order play_effect AfterCardExhausted kind relic>power, fix/exhaust-listener-order 2fcefac9 not landed); core2 runs old's rules for this (its family F11 is not in migrated_families.json), so it fails the same way.
